nodes.name: CC pretreatment
nodes.procedure: Commercial carbon cloth (CC) was cut into pieces of 2×6 cm², which was first washed with acetone, ethanol and water under the assistance of ultrasonication for 30 min, respectively. Then, CC was cleaned with HNO3 for 4 h to enhance the hydrophilicity and finally washed to pH = 7 with deionized water for further use.
nodes.source_text: Commercial carbon cloth (CC) was purchased from Ce Tech Co. Ltd. CC was cut into pieces of 2×6 cm², which was first washed with acetone, ethanol and water under the assistance of ultrasonication for 30 min, respectively. Then, CC was cleaned with HNO3 for 4 h...

nodes.name: CoNH/CC hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 4 mmol Cobalt (II) acetate tetrahydrate and 250 mg hexamethylenetetramine were dissolved in a mixed solvent of 13 mL ethylene glycol and 14 mL ethanol. A clear solution was obtained after continuously stirring for 30 min and then transferred to a 40 mL Teflon-lined autoclave with a piece of clean CC (2×6 cm²) in it. The Teflon-lined autoclave was heated to 170°C for 8 h. After cooling down to room temperature, the synthesized sample (CoNH/CC) was rinsed thoroughly with deionized water and dried at 60°C in oven for further use.

nodes.name: Co PBA/CC derivation
nodes.procedure: For the preparation of M(II)-Co(III) PBA, 0.15 mmol K3[Co(CN)6] was dissolved in 30 mL deionized water. Then, the transparent solution was transferred into a 40 mL Teflon-lined autoclave with a piece of CC covered with MNH in it. After that, the derivatization process was performed at 90°C for 24 h. After cooling to room temperature, the sample was washed with deionized water and vacuum dried.

nodes.name: Ru-doping by ion exchange
nodes.procedure: Ru-doped M(II)-Co(III) PBA was synthesized by a facile ion-exchange method. The CC covered with M(II)-Co(III) PBA was immersed in 20 mL RuCl3 aqueous solution (1 mg/mL) in dark for 10 h. The product was collected, rinsed with distilled water and dried in an oven at 60°C for use.

nodes.procedure: To prepare RuO2/(CoMn)3O4/CC, Ru-doped CoMn(II)-Co(III) PBA/CC was elevated to 350°C with the heating rate of 2°C/min in a muffle furnace under air atmosphere and maintained for 2 h.
